SymbolicEssence.ArchetypalFunction: To witness and reveal hidden transgressions; to embody the consequence of forbidden actions; to serve as guardian who reports violations.
SymbolicEssence.SymbolicCore: The witness who cannot stay silent, the tattler whose truth brings consequence.

MythicAppearances: Transformed into owl/screech owl by Demeter
CulturalContext.ReligiousOrRitualUse: Minor underworld deity; cautionary figure about consequences of revealing secrets; owl associations.
CulturalContext.HistoricalEvolution: Minor daemon in Persephone myth; transformation explains owl's nocturnal, watchful nature and mournful cry.

SymbolicRepresentation.ImageryNotes: Depicted as guardian daemon transformed into owl; associated with observation, revelation, and punishment for truth-telling.
SymbolicRepresentation.PoeticInvocation: Askalaphos, who saw what should not be revealed, transformed for speaking truth at the wrong time.
SymbolicRepresentation.DreamForm: An owl whose eyes saw the forbidden deed, forever cursed to hoot warnings in the dark

MetaIntegration.RitualFunction: Cautionary symbol about consequences of revealing secrets; represents the price of unwelcome truth.
AIPromptSeeds: The witness who spoke truth and was punished, forever transformed.
The guardian whose honesty brought curse upon himself.
NarrativeHooks: The witness who cannot stay silent
